Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (30 min call):
- CloudBridge is exploring a marketplace integration: a managed listing that routes provisioned customers to a Redwood Dedicated offering for inference.
- Key priorities: predictable latency for live inference, dedicated capacity options, and SSO/KMS requirements for enterprise buyers.
- Initial target workload: customer-facing chat + reranking for search, ~5M tokens/month to start, spike patterns during peak business hours.

Requested follow-ups / next steps:
1) Technical deep dive (partner-led) to align on architecture, expected latency SLOs, and integration points (marketplace procurement flow + SSO/KMS).
2) Share a concise architecture notes doc and a short discovery deck (attached) that outlines Redwood's Dedicated and Private deployment patterns.
3) Align on an exact list of customer personas and a mutual action plan for a marketplace pilot.

Proposed times for the partner-led technical deep dive (all PDT):
- Thu Apr 22, 9:00–10:00 AM
- Thu Apr 22, 11:00–12:00 PM
- Fri Apr 23, 8:00–9:00 AM

I attached the discovery deck and a short architecture notes doc for your review. If any of the above times work, I can send a calendar invite and include Jordan (our Solutions Engineer) and your SE.

Attachments: redwood-cloudbridge-discovery-deck.pdf, architecture-notes.docx

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

—Marissa
